<div class="sphinxpress-doc">
<section id="span-based-phonemization-guide">
<h1>Span-Based Phonemization Guide</h1>
<p>This document explains the span-based (offset-based) phonemization system in kokorog2p,
which provides deterministic, pipeline-friendly text-to-phoneme conversion.</p>
<section id="overview">
<h2>Overview</h2>
<p>The span-based system uses <strong>character offsets</strong> to precisely identify and override
specific portions of text during phonemization. This approach is more robust than
word-based matching because it handles:</p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Duplicate words</strong> with different pronunciations (e.g., “the cat the dog”)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Partial word matches</strong> (e.g., distinguishing “cat” from “category”)</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Complex text structures</strong> with punctuation and whitespace variations</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Pipeline integration</strong> with offset-preserving preprocessing</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="core-types">
<h2>Core Types</h2>
<section id="tokenspan">
<h3>TokenSpan</h3>
<p>Represents a single token with its phonemization and metadata:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@dataclass</span>
<span class="k">class</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">TokenSpan</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span>              <span class="c1"># Original text (&quot;hello&quot;)</span>
    <span class="n">char_start</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">int</span>        <span class="c1"># Character offset start (0)</span>
    <span class="n">char_end</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">int</span>          <span class="c1"># Character offset end (5)</span>
    <span class="n">lang</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>  <span class="c1"># Language override (&quot;en-us&quot;, &quot;fr&quot;, etc.)</span>
    <span class="n">extended_text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span> <span class="o">|</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>  <span class="c1"># Expanded text for phonemization</span>
    <span class="n">meta</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">dict</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">Any</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">field</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">default_factory</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">dict</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># Metadata including phonemes</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Key Properties:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">char_start</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">char_end</span></code> are <strong>character offsets</strong> in the clean text (after markup
removal)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">char_end</span></code> is <strong>exclusive</strong> (Python slice convention: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">text[char_start:char_end]</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p>Multiple tokens can reference the same text position if tokenization creates sub-parts</p></li>
<li><p>Whitespace is inferred from offsets (tokens are words/punctuation only)</p></li>
<li><p>Abbreviations keep trailing periods in the same token (e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Mr.</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">extended_text</span></code> holds optional expansions (e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Mr.</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">Mister</span></code> or <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">1</span></code> → <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">one</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p>Phonemes are stored in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">meta[&quot;phonemes&quot;]</span></code> after phonemization</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Hello Mr. Smith!&quot;</span>
<span class="n">tokens</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tokenize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># TokenSpan(text=&quot;Hello&quot;, char_start=0, char_end=5, ...)</span>
<span class="c1"># TokenSpan(text=&quot;Mr.&quot;, char_start=6, char_end=9, ...)</span>
<span class="c1"># TokenSpan(text=&quot;Smith&quot;, char_start=10, char_end=15, ...)</span>
<span class="c1"># TokenSpan(text=&quot;!&quot;, char_start=15, char_end=16, ...)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="overridespan">
<h3>OverrideSpan</h3>
<p>Specifies a region of text to override during phonemization:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@dataclass</span>
<span class="k">class</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">char_start</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">int</span>                 <span class="c1"># Character offset start</span>
    <span class="n">char_end</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">int</span>                   <span class="c1"># Character offset end (exclusive)</span>
    <span class="n">attrs</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">dict</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">]</span>           <span class="c1"># Override attributes</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Common Attributes:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ph</span></code>: Direct phoneme override (e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">{&quot;ph&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">&quot;həlˈO&quot;}</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p><code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lang</span></code>: Language switch (e.g., <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">{&quot;lang&quot;:</span> <span class="pre">&quot;fr&quot;}</span></code>)</p></li>
<li><p>Custom attributes for pipeline processing</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;the cat the dog&quot;</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ðə&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>   <span class="c1"># First &quot;the&quot; → /ðə/</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">11</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ði&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>  <span class="c1"># Second &quot;the&quot; → /ði/</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="phonemizeresult">
<h3>PhonemizeResult</h3>
<p>The complete phonemization output:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="nd">@dataclass</span>
<span class="k">class</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">PhonemizeResult</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="n">clean_text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span>                  <span class="c1"># Text with markup removed</span>
    <span class="n">tokens</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">TokenSpan</span><span class="p">]</span>          <span class="c1"># Token-level information with offsets</span>
    <span class="n">extended_text</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span>               <span class="c1"># Expanded text for phonemization</span>
    <span class="n">phonemes</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">str</span>                    <span class="c1"># Concatenated phoneme string</span>
    <span class="n">token_ids</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">]</span>             <span class="c1"># token IDs for model input</span>
    <span class="n">warnings</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">]</span>              <span class="c1"># Alignment warnings</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="extended-text-layer">
<h2>Extended Text Layer</h2>
<p>Span alignment always uses <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">clean_text</span></code> offsets. When abbreviations or numbers are
expanded for phonemization, the expanded form is stored on each token’s <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">extended_text</span></code>
and in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">PhonemizeResult.extended_text</span></code>. This keeps character offsets stable while
allowing the phonemizer to speak the expanded form.</p>
<p>Example:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Meet Mr. Smith&quot;</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># TokenSpan(text=&quot;Mr.&quot;, extended_text=&quot;Mister&quot;, char_start=5, char_end=8, ...)</span>
<span class="c1"># result.clean_text == &quot;Meet Mr. Smith&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># result.extended_text == &quot;Meet Mister Smith&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="character-offset-coordinate-system">
<h2>Character Offset Coordinate System</h2>
<section id="basic-rules">
<h3>Basic Rules</h3>
<ol class="arabic simple">
<li><p><strong>Zero-indexed</strong>: First character is at position <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">0</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><strong>Exclusive end</strong>: Range <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">[start,</span> <span class="pre">end)</span></code> means characters from <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">start</span></code> up to but not
including <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">end</span></code></p></li>
<li><p><strong>Clean text reference</strong>: Offsets refer to text <strong>after</strong> markup removal but
<strong>before</strong> normalization</p></li>
</ol>
</section>
<section id="examples">
<h3>Examples</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Hello world&quot;</span>
<span class="c1">#       0123456789...</span>

<span class="c1"># &quot;Hello&quot; → char_start=0, char_end=5</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;world&quot; → char_start=6, char_end=11</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot; &quot; (space) → char_start=5, char_end=6</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="with-markup">
<h3>With Markup</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Original: &quot;@Hello@ world&quot;  (with marker-based override)</span>
<span class="c1"># Clean text: &quot;Hello world&quot;</span>
<span class="c1">#              0123456789...</span>

<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;həlˈO&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Refers to &quot;Hello&quot; in clean text</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="duplicate-words">
<h3>Duplicate Words</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;the cat the dog&quot;</span>
<span class="c1">#       012345678901234...</span>

<span class="c1"># First &quot;the&quot; → OverrideSpan(0, 3, ...)</span>
<span class="c1"># Second &quot;the&quot; → OverrideSpan(8, 11, ...)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="alignment-modes">
<h2>Alignment Modes</h2>
<p>The system supports two alignment modes for applying overrides to tokens:</p>
<section id="span-alignment-default">
<h3>1. Span Alignment (Default)</h3>
<p><strong>Recommended for all new code.</strong> Uses character offsets for deterministic matching.</p>
<p><strong>Matching Logic:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><strong>Exact match</strong>: Override span exactly matches token span → Apply override</p></li>
<li><p><strong>Partial overlap</strong> (snap mode): Override partially overlaps token → Apply with
warning</p></li>
<li><p><strong>No overlap</strong>: Override doesn’t touch token → Skip</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Advantages:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>✅ Handles duplicate words correctly</p></li>
<li><p>✅ No ambiguity in complex text</p></li>
<li><p>✅ Predictable behavior for pipeline integration</p></li>
<li><p>✅ Works with partial word matches</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;the cat the dog&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ðə&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>
        <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">11</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ði&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">alignment</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;span&quot;</span>  <span class="c1"># default</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Both overrides applied to correct &quot;the&quot; instances</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="legacy-word-alignment">
<h3>2. Legacy Word Alignment</h3>
<p><strong>Deprecated.</strong> Uses word-text matching (first occurrence).</p>
<p><strong>Matching Logic:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Finds first token with matching text</p></li>
<li><p>Cannot distinguish between duplicate words</p></li>
<li><p>Provided only for backward compatibility</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Limitations:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>❌ Cannot handle duplicate words with different overrides</p></li>
<li><p>❌ Order-dependent behavior</p></li>
<li><p>❌ Fragile with whitespace/punctuation variations</p></li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;the cat the dog&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ðə&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>
        <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">11</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ði&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>  <span class="c1"># Will NOT work correctly!</span>
    <span class="p">],</span>
    <span class="n">alignment</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;legacy&quot;</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Only first &quot;the&quot; gets overridden (both overrides apply to same word)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="overlap-handling">
<h2>Overlap Handling</h2>
<p>When an override partially overlaps with a token, the system can handle it in two ways
via the <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">overlap</span></code> parameter in <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">phonemize()</span></code>:</p>
<section id="snap-mode-default">
<h3>Snap Mode (Default)</h3>
<p>Apply the override and emit a warning:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;category&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;kæt&quot;</span><span class="p">})],</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;cat&quot; is only part of &quot;category&quot;</span>
    <span class="n">overlap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;snap&quot;</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Override applied to entire &quot;category&quot; token</span>
<span class="c1"># Warning: &quot;Override span (0, 3) partially overlaps token boundaries; snapping to tokens...&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="strict-mode">
<h3>Strict Mode</h3>
<p>Skip the override and emit a warning on partial overlap:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">&quot;category&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;kæt&quot;</span><span class="p">})],</span>
    <span class="n">overlap</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;strict&quot;</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Override skipped</span>
<span class="c1"># Warning: &quot;Override span (0, 3) partially overlaps token boundaries; skipping (strict mode)&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="language-switching">
<h2>Language Switching</h2>
<p>Override spans can specify language changes for specific text regions:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Mix English and French in same sentence</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Hello Bonjour world&quot;</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">13</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;fr&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;Bonjour&quot; in French</span>
<span class="p">]</span>

<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;Hello&quot; → English G2P</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;Bonjour&quot; → French G2P</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;world&quot; → English G2P</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Language Codes:</strong></p>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p>Use standard language codes: <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">en-us</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">fr</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">de</span></code>, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">es</span></code>, etc.</p></li>
<li><p>See <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">get_g2p()</span></code> for supported languages</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
<section id="phoneme-overrides">
<h2>Phoneme Overrides</h2>
<p>Direct phoneme replacement bypasses G2P processing:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;read the book&quot;</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ɹˈEd&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;read&quot; as past tense</span>
<span class="p">]</span>

<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Uses provided phonemes for &quot;read&quot; instead of G2P lookup</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
<p><strong>Phoneme Override Priority:</strong> If both <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ph</span></code> and <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">lang</span></code> are specified, <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">ph</span></code> takes
precedence:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">&quot;lang&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;fr&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>
<span class="c1"># &quot;ph&quot; is used, &quot;lang&quot; is ignored for this span</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="custom-attributes">
<h2>Custom Attributes</h2>
<p>Override spans can carry custom attributes for downstream processing:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;həlˈO&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;speaker&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;male&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">&quot;emphasis&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;strong&quot;</span>
    <span class="p">})</span>
<span class="p">]</span>

<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Custom attributes stored in token.meta</span>
<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">token</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tokens</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">token</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">meta</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># {&quot;ph&quot;: &quot;həlˈO&quot;, &quot;speaker&quot;: &quot;male&quot;, &quot;emphasis&quot;: &quot;strong&quot;, ...}</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="best-practices">
<h2>Best Practices</h2>
<section id="use-span-alignment-default">
<h3>1. Use Span Alignment (Default)</h3>
<p>Always use span-based alignment unless you have a specific reason to use legacy mode:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># ✅ Good</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ❌ Avoid (unless backward compatibility required)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">alignment</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;legacy&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="compute-offsets-from-clean-text">
<h3>2. Compute Offsets from Clean Text</h3>
<p>Always compute offsets from the text <strong>after</strong> markup removal:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Original markup text</span>
<span class="n">markup_text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;[Hello]{ph=&#39;test&#39;} world&quot;</span>

<span class="c1"># Remove markup to get clean text</span>
<span class="n">clean_text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;Hello world&quot;</span>

<span class="c1"># Compute offsets from clean text</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;həlˈO&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Refers to &quot;Hello&quot; in clean_text</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="use-tokenize-for-debugging">
<h3>3. Use tokenize() for Debugging</h3>
<p>Inspect tokenization to understand offset positions:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">kokorog2p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">tokenize</span>

<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;the cat the dog&quot;</span>
<span class="n">tokens</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tokenize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">language</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;en-us&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">tok</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">tokens</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">tok</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="si">!r}</span><span class="s2"> → [</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">tok</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">char_start</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">:</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">tok</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">char_end</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">]&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># &#39;the&#39; → [0:3]</span>
<span class="c1"># &#39; &#39; → [3:4]</span>
<span class="c1"># &#39;cat&#39; → [4:7]</span>
<span class="c1"># ...</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="check-warnings">
<h3>4. Check Warnings</h3>
<p>Always inspect <code class="docutils literal notranslate"><span class="pre">result.warnings</span></code> to catch alignment issues:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">warnings</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">&quot;Alignment warnings:&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">warning</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">warnings</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">&quot;  - </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">warning</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="test-with-duplicates">
<h3>5. Test with Duplicates</h3>
<p>Always test your override logic with duplicate words:</p>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># ✅ Good test case</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;the cat saw the dog&quot;</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ðə&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>    <span class="c1"># First &quot;the&quot;</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">12</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">15</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ði&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>  <span class="c1"># Second &quot;the&quot;</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">assert</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">warnings</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="common-pitfalls">
<h2>Common Pitfalls</h2>
<section id="using-word-offsets-instead-of-character-offsets">
<h3>❌ Using Word Offsets Instead of Character Offsets</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># WRONG: These are word positions, not character offsets</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Trying to select first word</span>

<span class="c1"># RIGHT: Use character positions</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;hello world&quot;</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># &quot;hello&quot; is chars 0-5</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="ignoring-clean-text-vs-original-text">
<h3>❌ Ignoring Clean Text vs Original Text</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># Original with markers: &quot;@Hello@ world&quot;</span>
<span class="c1"># Clean: &quot;Hello world&quot;</span>

<span class="c1"># WRONG: Offsets based on original text with markers</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">7</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Includes marker chars</span>

<span class="c1"># RIGHT: Offsets based on clean text</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Just &quot;Hello&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="forgetting-exclusive-end">
<h3>❌ Forgetting Exclusive End</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;hello&quot;</span>
<span class="c1">#       01234</span>

<span class="c1"># WRONG: Inclusive end</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Only covers &quot;hell&quot;</span>

<span class="c1"># RIGHT: Exclusive end</span>
<span class="n">override</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;test&quot;</span><span class="p">})</span>  <span class="c1"># Covers &quot;hello&quot;</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
<section id="assuming-legacy-alignment-works-with-duplicates">
<h3>❌ Assuming Legacy Alignment Works with Duplicates</h3>
<div class="highlight-python notranslate"><div class="highlight"><pre><span></span><span class="c1"># WRONG: Legacy alignment cannot handle this correctly</span>
<span class="n">text</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">&quot;the cat the dog&quot;</span>
<span class="n">overrides</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ðə&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>
    <span class="n">OverrideSpan</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">8</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">11</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">&quot;ph&quot;</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="s2">&quot;ði&quot;</span><span class="p">}),</span>
<span class="p">]</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">alignment</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">&quot;legacy&quot;</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Both overrides apply to first &quot;the&quot; only!</span>

<span class="c1"># RIGHT: Use span alignment (default)</span>
<span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">phonemize</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">text</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">overrides</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">overrides</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># Correctly applies to each &quot;the&quot; instance</span>
</pre></div>
</div>
</section>
</section>
<section id="see-also">
<h2>See Also</h2>
<ul class="simple">
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="../api/core/"><span class="doc">Core API</span></a> - Main API functions</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="../markers/"><span class="doc">Marker-Delimited Helper Guide</span></a> - Convenient marker-based syntax for creating override spans</p></li>
<li><p><a class="reference internal" href="../quickstart/"><span class="doc">Quick Start</span></a> - Getting started with kokorog2p</p></li>
</ul>
</section>
</section>
</div>
<script data-sphinxpress-script="search" defer>
(function () {
  "use strict";

  function initForm(form) {
    var input = form.querySelector(".tool-search-input");
    var results = form.querySelector(".tool-search-results");
    var navList = form.parentElement
      ? form.parentElement.querySelector(".tool-nav-list")
      : null;
    if (!input || !results) {
      return;
    }
    var emptyText = form.getAttribute("data-search-empty") || "No matches.";
    var indexUrl = form.getAttribute("data-search-index");
    if (!indexUrl) {
      hideForm();
      return;
    }

    var indexEntries = null;
    var indexError = false;
    var pendingQuery = null;

    function hideForm() {
      form.style.display = "none";
    }

    function escapeHtml(value) {
      return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
    }

    function showEmpty() {
      results.innerHTML =
        '<p class="tool-search-empty">' + escapeHtml(emptyText) + "</p>";
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function clearResults() {
      results.innerHTML = "";
      results.hidden = true;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = false;
      }
    }

    function renderResults(entries, tokens) {
      if (!entries.length) {
        showEmpty();
        return;
      }
      var html = entries
        .map(function (entry) {
          var snippetHtml = renderSnippet(entry, tokens);
          var href = entry.url + "#sphinxpress-search-hit";
          return (
            '<li class="tool-search-result">' +
            '<a href="' +
            escapeHtml(href) +
            '">' +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-title">' +
            escapeHtml(entry.title) +
            "</p>" +
            '<p class="tool-search-result-snippet">' +
            snippetHtml +
            "</p>" +
            "</a>" +
            "</li>"
          );
        })
        .join("");
      results.innerHTML = html;
      results.hidden = false;
      if (navList) {
        navList.hidden = true;
      }
    }

    function renderSnippet(entry, tokens) {
      var source = entry.snippet || "";
      if (!source) {
        return "";
      }
      var lower = source.toLowerCase();
      var firstToken = tokens[0] || "";
      var idx = lower.indexOf(firstToken);
      if (idx < 0) {
        return escapeHtml(source);
      }
      var before = source.slice(0, idx);
      var match = source.slice(idx, idx + firstToken.length);
      var after = source.slice(idx + firstToken.length);
      return (
        escapeHtml(before) +
        "<mark>" +
        escapeHtml(match) +
        "</mark>" +
        escapeHtml(after)
      );
    }

    function runQuery(query) {
      if (!indexEntries) {
        return;
      }
      var tokens = query
        .toLowerCase()
        .split(/\s+/)
        .filter(function (token) {
          return token.length > 0;
        });
      if (!tokens.length) {
        clearResults();
        return;
      }
      var hits = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < indexEntries.length; i += 1) {
        var entry = indexEntries[i];
        if (!entry.sections || !entry.sections.length) {
          continue;
        }
        var matched = true;
        var score = 0;
        for (var t = 0; t < tokens.length; t += 1) {
          var token = tokens[t];
          var found = false;
          var tokenScore = 0;
          for (var s = 0; s < entry.sections.length; s += 1) {
            var section = entry.sections[s];
            var lowerText = section.lower || "";
            if (!lowerText) {
              continue;
            }
            var from = 0;
            while (from <= lowerText.length) {
              var foundAt = lowerText.indexOf(token, from);
              if (foundAt < 0) {
                break;
              }
              tokenScore += 1;
              from = foundAt + token.length;
            }
            if (tokenScore > 0) {
              found = true;
            }
          }
          if (!found) {
            matched = false;
            break;
          }
          score += tokenScore;
        }
        if (matched) {
          hits.push({ entry: entry, score: score });
        }
      }
      hits.sort(function (a, b) {
        return b.score - a.score;
      });
      var top = hits.slice(0, 20).map(function (hit) {
        return hit.entry;
      });
      renderResults(top, tokens);
    }

    function handleInput() {
      var query = input.value || "";
      if (!query.trim()) {
        clearResults();
        pendingQuery = null;
        return;
      }
      if (indexError) {
        hideForm();
        return;
      }
      if (indexEntries) {
        runQuery(query);
      } else {
        pendingQuery = query;
      }
    }

    input.addEventListener("input", handleInput);

    fetch(indexUrl, { credentials: "same-origin" })
      .then(function (response) {
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("HTTP " + response.status);
        }
        return response.json();
      })
      .then(function (payload) {
        if (
          !payload ||
          !Array.isArray(payload.entries) ||
          payload.entries.length === 0
        ) {
          hideForm();
          return;
        }
        indexEntries = payload.entries;
        if (pendingQuery) {
          runQuery(pendingQuery);
        }
      })
      .catch(function () {
        indexError = true;
        if (input.value && input.value.trim()) {
          hideForm();
        } else {
          hideForm();
        }
      });
  }

  function init() {
    var forms = document.querySelectorAll("form.tool-search");
    for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i += 1) {
      initForm(forms[i]);
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === "loading") {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();

</script>
{% endraw %}
